title: 第11章 简直像鬼一样。
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

她走出永夜局的大楼，果然看到一辆车牌号为A890的黑色轿车停在大门处。

张师傅远远看见她走来，便小跑下车拉开后车门。

她哪里享受过这阵仗，以往出去聚餐时她都是给周扒皮拉车门的那个，一时也有些尴尬起来，但为了不露出破绽，还是硬着头皮上了车。

上车坐好后张师傅正准备关门，司陇竟下意识地顺口说了句。

“谢谢。”

这个词一说出口她就恨不得抽死自己，司陇日常这冷艳打扮的杀人大魔头能说出来这么温柔的谢谢吗，简直笨蛋。

张师傅也一愣，诶诶的答应着，赶忙回到主驾驶后，悄悄透过后视镜看了一眼司陇，这往常的冷面魔王今天是怎么，竟然还谢谢起来了。

“副主任您现在回家还是？”他有些惶恐地问道。

“回家。”

“好的副主任，预计时间15分钟，您稍作休息，到达目的地后我会提醒您。”

车子行驶起来，窗外此时开始下起了淅淅沥沥的小雨。

她怔怔地看着窗外，街道两侧的霓虹广告灯倒映在积水里，被拖成模糊的光影，雨点滴落在车顶的声音很轻，但又极富节奏感。

十字路口的红绿灯提示音循环播放着，行人却寥寥无几。

司陇靠在后座，看见自己映在车窗上的影子，熟悉的五官陌生的妆容，与路边一个又一个的广告牌重叠，交错，又重叠。

她忽然有些分不清，这张脸究竟是属于自己，还是那一张张不同的广告牌里，面带笑容的仿生人。

车子放慢速度，缓缓停在一道安保门口，张师傅

司陇扫了一眼大门旁的牌子，雾栖湾。

还不错，这么有诗意的名字，比自己现实世界中住的500一间的人才公寓，听起来好听多了。

安保人员走近确认了一下，看到后排的司陇连忙微笑点头，示意安保亭岗内的工作人员快点开门放行。

就这样又过了一道安保，行驶一段距离后，车子才终于停下。

张师傅撑着伞，下车

“司副主任您家到了，明天您准备出门之前让深眠联系我，我很快就会过来接您。”

从车辆完全驶入雾栖湾后，司陇就开始觉得有些不对劲，震惊到差点没绷住。

面上一直强行维持着平静，内心早已激动到甚至有些涨红了脸。

我靠......我的家竟然在这里面？

没有搞错吧，这不是独栋别墅区吗，难道我在这个世界里，竟然是有钱人？！

“嗯。”

虽然内心里已经翻天覆地，但她也只轻轻蹦出了一个嗯。

黑色的轿车逐渐远去，暖黄的车灯在夜晚的别墅区里尤为显眼。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

She walked out of the Yongye Bureau building and saw a black car with license plate number A890 parked at the gate.

Master Zhang saw her coming from a distance, so he trotted out of the car and opened the rear door.

She had never enjoyed this fight before. In the past, she was the one who held the car door for Zhou Papi when going out for dinner. She felt a little embarrassed for a moment, but in order not to expose her flaws, she still got in the car.

After getting on the bus and sitting down, Master Zhang was about to close the door when Si Long said something subconsciously.

"Thank you."

As soon as the word came out of her mouth, she wanted to beat herself to death. How could Si Long, a murderous devil dressed in a cool dress, say such a gentle thank you? He was such an idiot.

Master Zhang was also stunned, and he agreed in a hurry. He quickly returned to the driver's seat and quietly glanced at Si Long through the rearview mirror. What happened to the usually cold-faced devil today? He even thanked him.

"Deputy Director, are you going home now or not?" he asked with some fear.

"Go home."

"Okay deputy director, the estimated time is 15 minutes. Please take a short rest. I will remind you when you arrive at your destination."

As the car started driving, light rain began to fall outside the window.

She stared blankly out the window. The neon advertising lights on both sides of the street were reflected in the stagnant water, and were dragged into blurred light and shadow. The sound of raindrops falling on the roof of the car was very soft, but very rhythmic.

The traffic light prompts at the intersection were playing in a loop, but there were very few pedestrians.

Si Long leaned on the back seat and saw his own shadow reflected on the car window. The familiar facial features and unfamiliar makeup overlapped, intertwined, and overlapped with the billboards one after another on the roadside.

She suddenly couldn't tell whether this face belonged to her own or the smiling androids on different billboards.

The car slowed down and stopped slowly at a security gate. Master Zhang

Si Long glanced at the sign next to the door, Wuqi Bay.

Not bad, such a poetic name sounds much better than the 500-room talent apartment I live in in the real world.

The security personnel came closer to confirm. Seeing Si Long in the back row, they quickly smiled and nodded, signaling the staff in the security booth to open the door quickly and let him go.

Just like that, after passing another security guard and driving for a while, the car finally stopped.

Master Zhang holds an umbrella and gets out of the car

"Deputy Director Si, your home has arrived. Ask Shenmian to contact me before you go out tomorrow. I will come to pick you up soon."

After the vehicle completely drove into Wuqi Bay, Si Long began to feel that something was wrong, and was so shocked that he almost lost his temper.

His face had been forced to remain calm, but his heart was already so excited that he even blushed a little.

Holy shit...my home is actually in here?

Isn't that wrong? Isn't this a single-family villa area? Am I actually a rich person in this world?!

"Yeah."

Although her heart was turned upside down, she only said a soft "hmm".

The black car gradually moved away, and its warm yellow car lights were particularly conspicuous in the villa area at night.
